article.title: Complete Access Hub (formerly Slate Digital Connect) - Release Notes
article.body:
2.19.0 (September 21, 2026)

  • The playground home page is now openable by everyone (no subscription required anymore). Plugin license check is now made when opening a session.
  • Installing VMR from "My Products" now installs owned modules only.
  • Added ability to sort sessions in Playground

2.18.0 (September 7, 2026)

  • Replaced product series page by filters
  • Playground: added preview button on session cards
  • Replaced Help page by a popup; release notes and logs have been moved to the Settings page
  • Show OS-native indicators (progress bar on Windows, app icon bump on macOS) to monitor product installations
  • Other minor improvements

2.16.0 (August 18, 2026)

  • Introducing Playground: a sandbox environment where you can quickly explore and enjoy our plugins in simple session scenarios.

Slate Digital Connect 1.8.0

July 19, 2023

We need YOU for (even) better plugins!

  • You've always dreamed of helping us improve our plugins? Now you can easily do that, just by using them as you always have, and allowing us to collect information about your use of Slate Digital's plugins from a new software brick included in Slate Digital Connect. Don't want to share this information with us? Don't worry, you can always manage what you want to share with us from the My Preferences menu in Slate Digital Connect. 📊

  • End-User License Agreement update: as we have recently joined the Audiotonix family, we have updated our EULA. You can access it using the latest Slate Digital Installer. 📖

Slate Digital Connect 1.5.0

February 23, 2023

Did you say "one-click" iLok licenses activation?

  • The main feature of this version is the ability to easily activate your iLok licenses directly inside Slate Digital Connect! In the "My Products" page, you will find a new button allowing you to Activate all your Slate Digital Products' licenses. Authorize Slate Digital to manage your iLok licenses and you're all set, we take care of activating your beloved plugins for you! ✨

  • ANA 2 Expansion Packs can now directly be installed. Enjoy the power of automatic installation. 🚀
  • Classic Instruments is now detected for Windows users. This little rogue of Classic Instruments didn't want to appear as "Installed" for Windows users. After negotiating with them, we were able to ensure they walk the line. 🫡
  • Some minor fixes and improvements have been implemented. Because we care a lot about your comfort! 🍵

Slate Digital Connect 1.4.0

August 25, 2022

What's new?

  • You can now sign in on Slate Digital Connect with your Slate Digital account! When signed in, you can access the new My Products page in the menu. There, you will be able to see every plugin you purchased, and if you have the All Access Pass, you will also see all the products you have access to! No more searching around in the whole list to find that one plugin you just bought. But not to worry—you can still use Slate Digital Connect without signing in.

  • ANA 2 Expansion Packs are now downloadable directly from Slate Digital Connect if you have the All Access Pass.
